summary.name: Cline
summary.one_liner: Cline is an open-source AI coding agent that makes multi-file code edits, runs terminal commands, and works in the editor, terminal, desktop app, or via an SDK.
use_cases: making coordinated changes across a codebase
running dev servers and tests from an agent
connecting an AI agent to databases and APIs via MCP
running coding agents in CI pipelines
using local or self-hosted models for coding
automating recurring dev tasks on a schedule
summary.what_it_does: Cline is an AI coding agent that can make coordinated changes across multiple files, showing diffs and checkpoints with one-click undo on each step. It has a Plan mode to agree on a strategy before a separate Act mode executes, with the option to approve each step or enable auto-approve. It runs commands in the terminal and reacts to live output, and it can be used in the editor, the terminal, a native desktop app, or embedded through an SDK. Users can connect models from Claude, GPT, Gemini, local Ollama or LM Studio, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and add MCP servers for external tools.
notable: Open source agent runtime with Plan and Act modes
Supports MCP servers and .clinerules project conventions
Can run headlessly in GitHub Actions, GitLab, or other pipelines
Works with any model provider including local models via Ollama or LM Studio
caveats: The page does not state specific pricing tiers; the directory listing labels it freemium
Page is mostly marketing; platform support beyond the named editor, terminal, and desktop app is not detailed
